item.title: Karnataka Road Accident: Bus-truck collision in Chitradurga; 10 killed, several injured
item.description: At least ten people were killed and several others injured in a major road accident in Karnataka’s Chitradurga district after a truck collided head-on with a private sleeper coach bus on National Highway 48. The incident occurred near Goralathu Cross in Hiriyur taluk.

item.title: Gold rises on Christmas, Silver extends gains; Check rates here
item.description: Gold prices rose on Christmas morning across India, with 24-carat gold touching ₹1,39,090 per 10 grams in Delhi, while silver also witnessed a sharp jump. Strong global cues and central bank buying supported bullion prices. Internationally, spot gold traded above $4,525 an ounce.

item.title: World’s coldest region Yakutia gripped by extreme winter; Temperatures drop to -60°C
item.description: Yakutia, one of the coldest inhabited regions on Earth, is facing extreme winter conditions with temperatures dropping as low as -60°C. Heavy snowfall and icy winds have disrupted daily life, forcing authorities to shut schools and kindergartens.

item.title: Australia: Jewish community targeted again; Car firebombed ahead of Christmas
item.description: A suspected antisemitic attack has shaken Australia again as a rabbi’s car was targeted in a firebombing incident in Melbourne just before Christmas. The attack occurred 11 days after the deadly Bondi Beach assault, deepening fear within the Jewish community.

item.title: PM Modi attends Christmas prayer at Cathedral Church in Delhi; Shares message of peace
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi attended a prayer service at the Cathedral Church of the Redemption in Delhi on Christmas Day. He shared a message of love, peace, and compassion. The church's magnificent decorations and architecture captivated the devotees.

item.title: Russia plans to build nuclear power station on the moon by 2036
item.description: Russia's ambitions suffered a major setback in August 2023 when its unmanned Luna-25 mission crashed while attempting to land on the lunar surface, and Elon Musk has revolutionized space vehicle launches – a field that was once Russia's specialty.

item.title: Tarique Rahman returns to Bangladesh after 17 years amid political turmoil
item.description: Amidst political turmoil in Bangladesh, former Prime Minister Khaleda Zia's son, Tarique Rahman, has returned to the country after 17 years. Meanwhile, Khodabakhsh Chowdhury, a special assistant to the Home Ministry under the interim government led by Chief Advisor Muhammad Yunus, has resigned.

item.title: CBI to challenge suspension of Kuldeep Sengar’s life sentence in Unnao rape case; Full story inside
item.description: A CBI official said that the decision was taken after studying the verdict of the Delhi High Court in the Unnao rape case of 2017.

item.title: New Kia Seltos production begins in India; Launch set for new year
item.description: Kia India has started production of the new generation model of its popular mid-size SUV, the Seltos, at its Anantapur plant in Andhra Pradesh. The new Seltos is larger, more premium, and packed with features. The company will announce the prices on January 2, 2026. Bookings have already started for ₹25,000, and deliveries are expected to begin in mid-January.

item.title: Which country celebrates New Year first in the world?
item.description: Kiribati, a small Pacific island nation near the International Date Line, is the first country to celebrate the New Year. With music, dancing, and family gatherings, it welcomes January 1 ahead of the rest of the world.
